ceiling: Configuration validation only, so it confirms a backup schedule, a restore-test schedule and the untested-backup flag are declared; it does not show data is recoverable.
offer: Schedule backups and independent restoration tests together. Successful backup creation cannot prove that the stored data can be recovered.

minimal.reason: Declare the backup schedule. Backups that run irregularly leave gaps, so set the cadence.

mid.reason: Declare how often restores are tested. A backup never restored is unproven, so schedule independent restore tests.

maximal.reason: Set backup without a restore test to false. Successful backup creation cannot prove recovery, so require a restore test.
